title: LVLme quick judgement (eval/quick.json in a quick folder)
description: The agent's judgement of one posting for LVLme quick: five factors with cited evidence ids, the warm path answer, the flags, the blind reviewer's flags and the candidate fixes. scripts/quick.py new writes the skeleton; scripts/quick.py build scores it with scripts/score.py's own functions. See skills/lvlme-quick/SKILL.md.

judged_by.description: Which AI agent, and model when known, made these judgements, for example {"agent": "Claude Code", "model": "claude-opus-5-5"}. Different agents can judge the same evidence differently, so the result page and the dashboard show it.

reviewed_by.description: Which separate agent did the blind review, for example {"agent": "Claude Code helper agent (lvlme:reviewer)", "model": "claude-opus-5-5"}. Only the agent that started the reviewer fills it in, and only when a separate reviewer really ran.

warm_path.description: The person's yes (true) or no (false) to the one warm path question; null until asked.

eligibility_cleared.description: Blocker types in the posting the person says they meet, as they state it.

eligibility_blocked.description: null: decided from the posting's blockers and eligibility_cleared.

review_flags.description: Flags the blind reviewer would set. Each is applied only when its posting sentence is really in the posting.

dismissed.description: Why the flag does not apply, citing an evidence id. Shown on the page.

fixes.description: Candidate fixes, one or more per factor that could rise. build ranks them by the fit points they add.

next_step.description: One concrete step the person takes. Never an application answer written for them.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads.
